skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target with 2 consecutive strikes.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 2 consecutive strikes, dealing 250% ATK DMG. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Specialized Corrode] on the main target and surrounding units. [Specialized Corrode]: Deals 120% ATK as Continuous DMG. After any character acts, transfers to a random valid target and disappears after transferring 5 times. Negates Extra DMG caused by DMG Reflect for the entire battle.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 2 consecutive strikes, dealing 400% ATK DMG. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Specialized Corrode] on the main target and surrounding units. [Specialized Corrode]: Deals 180% ATK as Continuous DMG. After any character acts, transfers to a random valid target and disappears after transferring 5 times. Negates Extra DMG caused by DMG Reflect for the entire battle.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: When enemies receive Continuous DMG, immediately deals Extra DMG to all enemies equal to 60% of that Continuous DMG. Only one effect of this type can take effect throughout the battle. Enemies affected by [Specialized Corrode] also gain [Stuck] for 2 rounds. [Stuck]: Prevents the affected unit from initiating [Follow-Up] and [Continuous Follow-Up].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: When enemies receive Continuous DMG, immediately deals Extra DMG to all enemies equal to 75% of that Continuous DMG. Only one effect of this type can take effect throughout the battle. Enemies affected by [Specialized Corrode] also gain [Stuck] for 2 rounds. [Stuck]: Prevents the affected unit from initiating [Follow-Up] and [Continuous Follow-Up].

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: When enemies receive Continuous DMG, immediately deals Extra DMG to all enemies equal to 80% of that Continuous DMG. Only one effect of this type can take effect throughout the battle. Enemies affected by [Specialized Corrode] also gain [Stuck] for 2 rounds. [Stuck]: Prevents the affected unit from initiating [Follow-Up] and [Continuous Follow-Up].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, permanently gains [Specialized DMG Reflect]. [Specialized DMG Reflect]: Reduces Direct DMG and Extra DMG received by 50%, and reflects Extra DMG equal to 50% of the original DMG back to the attacker. After any character acts, absorbs 100% of the Continuous DMG suffered by enemies to restore own [Specialized Guard].

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, permanently gains [Specialized DMG Reflect]. [Specialized DMG Reflect]: Reduces Direct DMG and Extra DMG received by 50%, and reflects Extra DMG equal to 50% of the original DMG back to the attacker. After any character acts, absorbs 100% of the Continuous DMG suffered by enemies to restore [Specialized Guard] for self and allies in the same row.

effects.desc: Control status prevents the target from casting [Follow-up] and [Consecutive Follow-up], usually for 2 turns.
Debuffs apply to all enemies, often accompanied by corrosive damage over time, negating their effects.
